shortDescription: Manage AD FS claim rules on a Relying Party Trust

options.name: authorization_rules
options.description: Issuance Authorization Rules to apply to the trust. These rules define who is authorized to receive a token for the relying party.

options.name: name
options.description: The display name of the Relying Party Trust to manage rules on.

options.name: state
options.description: When V(present), the specified rules are set or appended. When V(absent), all issuance transform and authorization rules are cleared from the trust.

options.name: transform_rules
options.description: Issuance Transform Rules to apply to the trust. These rules define how incoming identity claims are mapped or transformed before being sent to the relying party.
